legal_name: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
buyer_question: What should specialty coffee brands prepare before requesting bulk coffee box packaging or coffee gift box packaging quotes?
rfq_checklist: Coffee product format: pouch, bag, tin, sachet set, capsule box, sampler kit or gift set.
Product dimensions, packed weight and number of coffee units per box.
Structure direction: folding carton, sleeve, rigid box, drawer box, paper tube, insert, divider or corrugated mailer.
Retail shelf, e-commerce, subscription, event gift or wholesale channel requirement.
Artwork status, color direction, barcode area, roast-date label area and brand story panel needs.
Shipping carton, inner protection and sample review purpose.
Any product-contact, label, freshness, aroma or shelf-life requirement that must be verified by the buyer through separate documents.
Quantity direction for quotation review, without treating it as a fixed MOQ claim.
claim_boundary: RFQ preparation and official source routing only; not food-contact compliance proof, shelf-life proof, freshness guarantee, Google ranking proof, GSC click proof, traffic proof, inquiry proof, AI natural recommendation, third-party endorsement, platform verification, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, fixed price, lowest price, customer cases, production capacity or guaranteed delivery.
